name: ai-task-list

frames.best_why: Shows a mix of green-checked steps, the moving running underline and pending rows at 5/7.

tagline: A live plan checklist that ticks off steps as an agent works through them.
summary: A bordered panel headed Plan lists nested task rows with square checkboxes, and a count of finished steps sits at the top right. A green check draws in as each step completes while a moving underline marks the one still running.
appearance: A dark rounded panel headed Plan with a small done count on the right, listing nested rows of a 14px square checkbox, a task label and an optional right-aligned note such as 3 jobs. Completed rows carry a green box and check and sit slightly dimmed.
behaviour: As a step finishes its box fills and a green check draws in, the row dims and nudges down a pixel, and the header count rises. The active row carries a thin glowing underline sweeping left to right on a loop; with every step done nothing is running.
demo_content: An agent fixing a flaky checkout test: read CI logs, reproduce, patch a race, run the suite 20x.
search_phrases: steps that tick off as they finish
ai plan list with running step
nested task list with live underline
checklist with a done count header
task progress list for coding assistant
use_when: An assistant runs a multi-step job and the user needs to see what is done, what is running and what comes next.
avoid_when: Finished rows drop to 65% opacity, so a long fully completed plan becomes faint to read.
customise: Pass a tasks array of id, label, status, an optional note and one level of children; the heading label is a prop. Colours, check marks and timing need a source edit.
weight_why: A short list, one CSS-drawn checkmark and a single looping underline; idle once all steps finish.

a11y.note: Status lives only in colour and a drawn check, and the box SVG is aria-hidden, so a screen reader hears labels without pending, running or done.

issues: Finished rows fade to 65% opacity, making a fully completed plan low contrast.
polish_why: Drawn checks and one travelling underline tell the story clearly; done rows get faint.
title: AI Task List
